title: DiffImaginE: Imagine to Verify Entity Types with Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2608.03025v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal named entity recognition (MNER) determines whether each candidate span and entity-type hypothesis is supported by joint textual and visual evidence. Existing imagine-and-compare verifiers map each (span, type) pair to one predicted visual feature, compressing diverse visual realisations into a single prototype and providing a compatibility score without explicit probabilistic semantics. We introduce DiffImaginE, which formulates MNER type verification as conditional latent diffusion inference. Given span-localised visual evidence, a type-conditioned denoiser predicts noise injected into its standardised latent. The resulting denoising error provides an ELBO-consistent surrogate for type-conditional negative log-likelihood, allowing competing type hypotheses to be ranked by how well they explain the observation. DiffImaginE retains a standard multimodal encoder stack and replaces the deterministic verifier with a classifier

translated_title: DiffImaginE：通过扩散想象来验证实体类型
translated_abstract: 多模态命名实体识别（MNER）判断每个候选片段和实体类型假设是否得到联合文本和视觉证据的支持。现有的“想象并比较”验证器将每个（片段，类型）对映射到一个预测的视觉特征，将多样的视觉表现压缩成单一原型，并提供兼容性分数，而不具备明确的概率语义。我们引入了DiffImaginE，将MNER类型验证表述为条件潜在扩散推理。给定片段定位的视觉证据，一个类型条件的去噪器预测注入其标准化潜在表示中的噪声。由此产生的去噪误差提供了类型条件负对数似然的ELBO一致替代，使竞争的类型假设能够根据它们解释观测的能力进行排序。DiffImaginE保留了标准的模态编码器堆栈，并用分类器替换了确定性验证器。
tldr: DiffImaginE利用条件潜在扩散推理进行多模态实体类型验证，通过去噪误差提供ELBO一致的概率分数，从而更准确地排序实体类型假设。
en_tdlr: DiffImaginE leverages conditional latent diffusion inference for multimodal entity type verification, using denoising error as an ELBO-consistent probabilistic score to better rank entity type hypotheses.
